title: Positive second moment from positive norm
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set and let $X\colon\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$. If the $L^2$ norm of $X$ under the uniform probability measure on $\Omega$ is positive, then its second moment is positive: $\mathbb{E}_{x\in\Omega}[X(x)^2]>0$.
hypotheses_covered: The uniform $L^2$ norm of $X$ is positive
